$comment: Single source of truth for the pinned libmpv development package.
Windows CI, scripts/fetch-mpv-dev.ps1 and the CMake build-info all read this file.
The pin that actually bites is the digest, not the tag: GitHub release assets are
mutable, so upstream can re-publish different bytes under the same tag (it did for
2026-09-07-989d32716e, see repinNote below). After changing this file always run
scripts/fetch-mpv-dev.ps1, which verifies asset and extracted hashes.
To upgrade: pick a release tag from https://github.com/zhongfly/mpv-winbuild/releases,
update tag/asset/assetSha256/extracted hashes, re-extract locally, commit the refreshed
git-tracked headers and libmpv.dll.a together so the tracked ABI stays in lockstep.
Prefer a newer tag over re-hashing the current one, so tag and bytes stay 1:1.

windows.repinNote: 2026-09-08: assetSha256 and extracted libmpv-2.dll refreshed after upstream re-published this tag's asset (manual Daily Build re-run on 2026-09-07 at 12:33Z, i.e. after the lock commit that recorded 098417b1...). libmpv.dll.a is unchanged: COFF import libraries survive a rebuild byte-identical, while the runtime DLL embeds a new PDB GUID. Upstream did not cut a new tag, so tag and bytes are deliberately NOT 1:1 here; the digests are the pin.

baselines.$comment: Documented build environments that cannot be byte-pinned by this lock. The startup log records the actual runtime version, so any drift is traceable per report.

flatpak.note: libmpv comes from the Flatpak runtime; the runtime version is pinned in packaging/flatpak/build-bundle.sh.

externalFfmpeg.note: Bundling/pinning the external ffmpeg executable used by M3U8S packaging is an explicitly deferred task (2026-07-13).
